answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. What survives to the jetty is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, reset on any identity-link attempt, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Each submission hangs on the forge of a task receipt, and the karst is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
